subject: Technical kickoff: proposed slots + evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Technical kickoff: proposed slots + evidence roadmap

Thanks again for the call this morning, Emma — great discussion and I appreciate the clarity on the integration priorities. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can lock the technical kickoff: 

High-level recap:
- Goal: 45-minute technical deep dive to validate integration path for API + SSO + data retention model.
- Key stakeholders you flagged: Platform (API owners), Security, and Procurement.
- Target timeline: try to get the deep dive on the books this week or early next week to keep PoC momentum.

Proposed 45-minute slots (all ET):
1) Wed Mar 11 — 11:00–11:45am ET
2) Thu Mar 12 — 2:00–2:45pm ET
3) Fri Mar 13 — 9:30–10:15am ET

Please reply with the option that works, or send two alternatives and we’ll do calendar invites. If you want platform and security on the same call, we can extend to 60 minutes — let us know.

Requested prep (so we bring the right people):
- Emma: confirm which platform owner will join (name + email).
- Procurement: if you want pricing and contract preliminaries discussed, copy your procurement contact into the thread so we can share an initial quote and MAP.
- Security: we’ll attach a one-page SOC2 summary and a short data-flow diagram (see attachments) — Mina (cc) will handle scope questions.

Attachments included: redwood-inference-soc2-summary.pdf (1p), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (starter MAP).

Next step from our side: once you confirm a slot we’ll send a calendar invite that includes the agenda and a short list of access items (sandbox creds / sample data) so the engineering team can prepare.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

---

From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@finovate.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@finovate.com>, procurement@finovate.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Technical kickoff: proposed slots + evidence roadmap

Thanks Sean — helpful recap. We’re keen to move quickly.

Quick replies:
- Platform owner: I’ll invite our API lead, Mike Torres (mike.torres@finovate.com). Please include a brief run-of-show in the invite.
- Procurement: tagging procurement@finovate.com — they’ll want an initial ballpark for monthly committed spend and any overage rates; Sarah (cc) will own the PO/contract side.
- Security: we need a SOC2 summary and any details about data-at-rest encryption and retention windows before security joins. If you can share the one-page now that would help speed review.

Preferred slot: Thu Mar 12 — 2:00–2:45pm ET looks best for the group. If procurement needs to join, they may push to 60 minutes.

Can you also send a short quote (PDF) and MAP so procurement can start internal routing?

Emma
Emma Clarke
Senior Product Manager, Finovate Labs
emma.clarke@finovate.com

Subject: Re: Technical kickoff: proposed slots + evidence roadmap

Emma / Sarah / procurement team — looping in Karthik (solutions engineer) and Mina (security) to accelerate the prep. 

Per Emma’s note, attaching a short quote (quote-v3.pdf) and an updated mutual-action-plan. Karthik will own the technical agenda and demo flow; Mina will own the security Q&A.

Please find the quick artifacts attached:
- quote-v3.pdf — initial ballpark based on committed capacity for a 6-month PoC.
- redwood-inference-soc2-summary.pdf — 1-page SOC2 coverage summary; Mina added inline notes addressing encryption at rest and retention.
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx — suggested milestones and owners.

Agenda proposal for Thu Mar 12, 2:00–3:00pm ET (60 min if procurement joins):
1) 5m intro & goals (Sean)
2) 15m demo: integration pattern + API walk-through (Karthik)
3) 15m security: data flow, retention, SSO (Mina)
4) 15m procurement & next steps (Marissa / Sean)
5) 10m Q&A / follow-ups

Access items Karthik will request in the invite: sandbox API key, sample dataset (anonymized), and SAML metadata if you want SSO evaluated.

If Thu 2pm is confirmed I’ll send the calendar invite and include calendar holds for platform + security + procurement.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199

Thanks Marissa — Thu Mar 12, 2:00–3:00pm ET works for us. I’ve added Mike (platform) and Sarah (procurement). Procurement confirms they will attend for the first 30 minutes. 

Sarah will start internal routing for the PO; I’m attaching our internal procurement intake form (procurement-intake.xlsx) for your team to complete. We’ll get it moving in parallel.

Also: can Mina call out any red flags re: data residency or within the SOC2 summary before the call? Even a bullet list would be helpful.

See you all on Thu — please send the invite with the agenda and sandbox access checklist.

Best,
Emma
